content: Ekkema ch'irerek s'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin ka Jọrdan
Ma wọ ode obe f'anọng p'Israẹl atzọk mach'ekkema chabẹ k'irerek sa Kenaan, s'iwa Eleaza kw'ode ọfọhnẹja, ọmaana Joshua kw'ode nnwa kwa Nun ttara adeho pa ngọma s'Israẹl akkem anang bẹ.
Wa bẹ abhari ose, atzima akkema ngọma nna ọhawani ọmaana ibhaakha, mach'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'Mosẹs ọtzọhna.
Ode ch'iwa Mosẹs okk'ngọma mfa ọmaana ibhaakha ekkema chabẹ ọnanga k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin ka Jọrdan. Yina, wa efonamma cha Lẹvi ekkema kọnangi,

da va pa va pa Josẹph akk'ngọma mfa, sa nde Manasẹ ọmaana Ephraim ada. Wa ẹnọmma cha Lẹvi ekkema k'irerek nnuma kẹtzọk, ayongi ibhon sa bẹ arukhi sẹ-sẹ, ọmaana iwoni s'araraari s'arukhimaan ọmaana abhaam pabẹ am-achi ọttọhk.
Mando kw'anọng p'Israẹl akkem irerek nna atzor mach'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'bẹ ọtzọhna.

Iwa anọng pa Juda afona atza akhebha Joshua ka Gilgal, Kalẹb kw'ode nnwa kwa Jephunẹ kw'ofon Keniz oben Joshua bi, “Kọ arong odik kw'iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ogbaakhi Mosẹs kw'ode ọtzọhmnọng kw'Ibinọkpaabyi, ka Kadẹsh Barnea kw'okhuri kaam ọmaana kọ kẹ.
Wa kaam nde cho arọbh afa k'ogbe kwa Mosẹs kw'ode ọtzọhmnọng kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, ọtzọhm-m ka Kẹdẹsh Barnea, bi nda nnom irerek nnuma. Wa ndor k'ekhera chaam, ndima ẹkkaabha ọkkakka nchen-ẹ.

Yina, wa ayokh-obhon paam p'Israẹl, pa mọtzọni ovura kẹ, atzima ẹkkabha-tzama, ch'iwa ekhe anọng ojora ka nttem. Kaam ndim ettem obungichẹ chaam ndọn Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwaam abẹ.

Mẹ wọ ofon, wa Mosẹs ochekhi ọnang-m m'ewu nduma bi, ‘Irerek nna s'akk'mmo sọ abari íde ekkema chọ, ọmaana ekkama cha va pa va pọ maa, ikhina ogbe ode, okhuri bi, kọ akk'ettem obungichẹ chọ atzima atzọn Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kwaam abẹ.’

“Mẹ wọ ofon, odem nwa kw'iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ochekhi, okk'aam akpen ohokha ka cho arọbh afa obhiri azen, ttẹwọr k'ogbe kw'ọgbaakhi Mosẹs odik nwa, mada anọng p'Israẹl am-akpaanga akhọri ibe s'anọng an-arukhi. Ma mayina kaam nna nde cho arọbh anna obhiri azen!
Kaam ndimi mingaama ẹfa mayina, mach'ewu ch'iwa Mosẹs ọtzọhm-m bi nda orenga nwuma. Ẹfa ch'egbong etzim ewobh-m ka mach'iwa.

Kọ nang-m okhubha nwa kwa mgbegbeho, kw'iwa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'ochekhi m'ewu nduma ọnang-m. Wa kọ ọkhaam akk'abhaanga bi, anọng p'Anak bọ iwa arukhi mẹ, ọmaana bi, wa ibhon sabẹ ibari-ọbar, ibiri ikhaama mbaakhamma. Yina, k'ẹfa ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kaam ńgwubh bẹ okhwubh mach'iwa kẹ ọgbaakhi.”
Wa Joshua osi Kalẹb kw'ode nnwa kwa Jephunẹ ittabọhng, obiro ọnang-ẹ obhon kwa Hẹbrọn mach'ekkema chẹ.
Ttẹwọr mẹ, wa Hẹbrọn on-ode ekkema cha Kalẹb, kw'ode nnwa kwa Jephunẹ kw'ofon Keniz, da iwa kẹ otzim ettem obungichẹ, ọtzọn Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Israẹl abẹ.
(Wa bẹ am-ayeri Hẹbrọn, Kiriyat-Arba abhina Arba kw'iwa ode okkengitza k'ottem kw'anọng p'Anak.) Mẹ wọ ofon, wa anọng p'ẹkhọma nda egbong dọk karim.
